title: Application Security Engineer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan that builds foundational knowledge, core security skills, portfolio projects, and job‑ready habits. Tailored for engineers who already code and want to specialize in application security.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish the security basics and terminology needed for every later step.

milestones.title: Security Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can explain core security concepts and common vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Read OWASP Top 10 Overview
tasks.description: Study the OWASP Top 10 page and note one example for each category.

tasks.title: Watch Crypto Basics on Khan Academy
tasks.description: Complete the introductory video on symmetric and asymmetric encryption.

tasks.title: Summarize Key Terms
tasks.description: Write a one‑page glossary of terms like threat model, attack surface, and least privilege.

tasks.title: Create Flashcards in Anki
tasks.description: Add 20 cards covering the OWASP categories and crypto primitives.

milestones.title: Secure Development Lifecycle
milestones.outcome: Can outline a secure SDLC and map security activities to each phase.

tasks.title: Read Microsoft SDL Documentation
tasks.description: Read the high‑level overview and note the five phases.

tasks.title: Map Existing Project to SDL
tasks.description: Take a recent personal project and annotate where security checks would occur.

tasks.title: Draft Personal SDL Checklist
tasks.description: Create a concise checklist for design, coding, testing, and release.

tasks.title: Discuss Checklist with a Peer
tasks.description: Explain your checklist to a colleague and gather feedback.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop hands‑on abilities in threat modelling, code review, and CI security tooling.

milestones.title: Threat Modelling
milestones.outcome: Can produce a STRIDE threat model for a small web app.

tasks.title: Read Microsoft Threat Modeling Guide
tasks.description: Study the guide’s methodology and sample diagrams.

tasks.title: Identify Assets for Sample App
tasks.description: List data stores, APIs, and user roles for an open‑source note‑taking app.

tasks.title: Create STRIDE Diagram in Draw.io
tasks.description: Draw a threat model covering Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information Disclosure, Denial of Service, and Elevation of Privilege.

tasks.title: Review Model with Community
tasks.description: Post the diagram on a security forum and incorporate at least two suggestions.

milestones.title: Secure Code Review
milestones.outcome: Can conduct a focused security code review and report findings.

tasks.title: Read OWASP Code Review Guide
tasks.description: Read the guide and note the top 5 review focus areas.

tasks.title: Select Open‑Source Repo on GitHub
tasks.description: Pick a recent JavaScript repo with at least 5 k lines of code.

tasks.title: Perform Security Review of One Module
tasks.description: Apply the checklist and write a short report of three findings.

tasks.title: Discuss Findings with Repo Owner
tasks.description: Open a pull‑request comment and suggest mitigations.

milestones.title: CI Security Tooling
milestones.outcome: Can integrate static analysis and dependency scanning into a CI pipeline.

tasks.title: Watch GitHub Actions Security Intro
tasks.description: View the official GitHub Actions security video and note available security actions.

tasks.title: Set Up a Sample Repo on GitHub
tasks.description: Create a new repo and push a simple Node.js app.

tasks.title: Add CodeQL Analysis Action
tasks.description: Configure CodeQL in the workflow and run a scan.

tasks.title: Add Dependency‑Check Step
tasks.description: Integrate OWASP Dependency‑Check into the pipeline and view the report.

tasks.title: Document CI Security Steps
tasks.description: Write a README section describing each security action and why it’s needed.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase threat modelling, CI security, and secure‑coding guidance.

milestones.title: Threat Model Portfolio Project
milestones.outcome: A polished threat‑model document ready for a portfolio site.

tasks.title: Choose Open‑Source App
tasks.description: Select a popular open‑source web app (e.g., Mattermost) to model.

tasks.title: Produce Full STRIDE Model
tasks.description: Create a detailed diagram and narrative covering all components.

tasks.title: Write Executive Summary
tasks.description: Summarize risks and mitigations in 300 words for non‑technical readers.

tasks.title: Publish on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Add the model and summary to a public repo and enable GitHub Pages.

tasks.title: Gather Feedback from Peers
tasks.description: Ask two security professionals to review and incorporate suggestions.

milestones.title: CI Pipeline with Security Checks
milestones.outcome: A reusable CI workflow that runs static analysis, secret scanning, and dependency checks.

tasks.title: Fork Sample Node.js Repo
tasks.description: Clone a starter repo to work on locally.

tasks.title: Add CodeQL, Trivy, and Dependabot
tasks.description: Configure three security actions in a single workflow file.

tasks.title: Trigger Pipeline on Pull Request
tasks.description: Open a PR and verify all security jobs succeed or report findings.

tasks.title: Write Blog Post Explaining Setup
tasks.description: Create a short post describing each tool and its value.

tasks.title: Share Post on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Publish the article and note any engagement or questions.

milestones.title: Secure‑Coding Guide
milestones.outcome: A concise guide that demonstrates best practices for input validation, authentication, and error handling.

tasks.title: Research OWASP Secure Coding Practices
tasks.description: Read the OWASP Secure Coding Cheat Sheet and list five key recommendations.

tasks.title: Draft Guide Sections
tasks.description: Write three sections: Input Validation, Auth & Crypto, Error Handling.

tasks.title: Add Code Samples in Python and JavaScript
tasks.description: Provide before‑and‑after snippets illustrating the fixes.

tasks.title: Create PDF and Host on GitHub
tasks.description: Generate a PDF, add it to a repo, and enable a download link.

tasks.title: Request Review from Senior Engineer
tasks.description: Send the guide to a mentor and incorporate feedback.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish professional habits, deepen expertise, and prepare for interviews or client engagements.

milestones.title: Advanced Threat Modelling
milestones.outcome: Can apply attack‑tree analysis and quantitative risk scoring to complex systems.

tasks.title: Read Threat Modeling: Designing for Security Book Chapter
tasks.description: Study the chapter on attack trees and risk scoring.

tasks.title: Add Attack Tree to Existing Model
tasks.description: Extend the portfolio threat model with an attack‑tree diagram.

tasks.title: Calculate CVSS Scores for Top Risks
tasks.description: Assign CVSS v3.1 scores to the three highest‑impact threats.

tasks.title: Present Findings to a Small Group
tasks.description: Give a 10‑minute talk to peers and answer questions.

milestones.title: Developer Communication
milestones.outcome: Can convey security findings clearly and influence engineering decisions.

tasks.title: Read "The Art of Security Communication" Blog Post
tasks.description: Identify three techniques for framing security advice positively.

tasks.title: Write a Security Advisory Email
tasks.description: Draft an email recommending a fix for a recent code‑review finding.

tasks.title: Role‑Play a Security Meeting
tasks.description: Simulate a meeting with a developer, focusing on listening and collaborative problem solving.

tasks.title: Gather Feedback from Mentor
tasks.description: Ask a senior engineer to critique your communication style.

milestones.title: Interview & Consulting Prep
milestones.outcome: Ready to demonstrate expertise in interviews or client workshops.

tasks.title: Complete LeetCode Security‑Focused Problems
tasks.description: Solve 5 problems that involve input validation and authentication logic.

tasks.title: Mock Technical Interview on Security
tasks.description: Partner with a peer to run a 45‑minute interview covering threat modelling and code review.

tasks.title: Prepare 5‑Minute Pitch of Portfolio Projects
tasks.description: Create a concise slide deck highlighting each project’s impact.

tasks.title: Review Resume for Security Keywords
tasks.description: Update the resume to include the key skills and project titles.
